desc.en:
Attacks 2 enemies and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_2_1] turn(s)</color>.

If the caster has the <color=#28d9ed>Crit DMG Incr</color>, the attack changes to a single-target attack, and the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Walpurgis' Light!</color> is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_3] turn(s)</color>.

If the target is an Earth Element, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_4]</color>.
desc.jp:
敵2体を攻撃し、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_2_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。

自分に<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージUP</color>効果がある場合、敵1体を攻撃し、<color=#28d9ed>ワルプルギスの光！</color>のスキルターンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_3]ターン</color>DOWNさせる。

対象が地属性の場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_4]</color>UPする。
desc.kr:
적 2인을 공격하고, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_2_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.

자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해 증가</color> 효과가 있다면 적 1인을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>발푸르기스의 빛!</color>의 쿨타임을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_3]턴</color> 감소시킵니다.

대상이 지속성이라면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_4]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
攻击2名敌人，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_2_1]回合</color>。

若自身持有<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害提升</color>效果，则攻击1名敌人，并使<color=#28d9ed>瓦尔普吉斯之光！</color>的冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_3]回合</color>。

若目标为地属性，则自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动条</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700005_2_4]</color>。

desc.en:
Before using the skill, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Crit Damage</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_3_1] turn(s)</color>, then attacks all enemies.

If the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Increased Penetration</color>, ignores <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> of the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.

If the target is an <color=#28d9ed>Earth</color> enemy, ignores an additional <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.
desc.jp:
スキル使用前、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_3_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせ、敵全体にダメージを与える。

自分に<color=#28d9ed>貫通力UP</color>効果がある場合、対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>の<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>を貫通する。

対象が地属性の場合、<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>の<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>を追加で貫通する。
desc.kr:
스킬 사용 전 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_3_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시키고, 적 전체를 공격합니다.

자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>관통력 증가</color> 효과가 있다면 대상 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>를 무시합니다.

대상이 지속성이라면 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>의 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>를 추가로 무시합니다.
desc.zh:
使用技能前，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700005_3_1]回合</color>，并攻击全体敌人。

若持有<color=#28d9ed>穿透力提升</color>效果，则无视目标<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。

若目标为地属性，则额外无视<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。

DMG further increases the fewer the number of targets,\nand deals greater DMG to Bosses.

desc.kr: 적 전체를 강격으로 공격하고 자신의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000008_2_2]</color> 회복합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다. 대상의 수가 적을수록 피해가 추가로 증가하고\n보스에게는 더 큰 피해를 입힙니다.
desc.zh: 对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>强击</color>伤害，并恢复自身生命值<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000008_2_2]</color>。\n自身<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，伤害越高。目标数量越少，伤害进一步提升，\n对首领造成更高伤害。

desc.en: Reduces <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3] turn(s)</color> (Ignores Resilience) before attacking all enemies with Heavy Strike.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> and additionally increases inversely proportional to the number of targets.\nDeals more damage to bosses and gains an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color>.
desc.jp: スキル発動前に対象全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせ(効果抵抗無視)、敵全体に強撃でダメージを与える。\n自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPし、対象が少ないほどダメージが追加でUPする。\nボスにはより大きなダメージを与え、自分には<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。
desc.kr: 스킬 사용 전 대상 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3]턴</color> 동안 감소시키고(효과 저항 무시) 적 전체를 강격으로 공격합니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가하며 대상이 적을수록 피해가 추가로 증가합니다.\n보스에게는 더 큰 피해를 입히고 자신은 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 얻습니다.
desc.zh: 在技能发动前，使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000008_3_3]</color>回合（无视效果抵抗），然后以强击攻击全体敌人。\n自身<color=#28d9ed>最大生命值</color>越高伤害越高，目标越少伤害越大。\n对Boss造成更高伤害，自身获得<color=#28d9ed>追加回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. With a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000015_1_1]</color> chance, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_1_1] turns</color>, and if the target is a Boss, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> <color=#28d9ed>1</color> additional time. (Ignores Resilience)\nAfter attacking, if the target is in <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> state, own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> increases by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_1_3]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000015_1_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_1_1]ターン</color>の間付与し、対象がボスなら<color=#28d9ed>1回</color>追加付与する。（効果抵抗無視）\n攻撃後、対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_1_3]</color>UPする。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000015_1_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_1_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여하고 대상이 보스라면 <color=#28d9ed>1회</color> 추가 부여합니다. (효과 저항 무시)\n공격 후 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_1_3]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000015_1_1]</color>的概率对目标附加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_1_1]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>，若目标为首领，则额外附加<color=#28d9ed>1次</color>。（无视效果抵抗）\n攻击后若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_1_3]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_1] turns</color>. (Ignores Resilience)\nIf the target is <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> , DMG increases and performs an <color=#28d9ed>Additional Attack</color> on the same target.\nAfter attacking, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_4] turns</color> and if the target is Bleeding, increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_2_3]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。（効果抵抗無視）\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPし、同じ対象に<color=#28d9ed>追加攻撃</color>を与える。\n攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_4]ターン</color>の間UPさせ、対象が出血状態の場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_2_3]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다. (효과 저항 무시)\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 피해량이 증가하고 동일한 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>추가 공격</color>을 사용합니다.\n공격 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_4]턴</color> 동안 증가시키고 대상이 출혈 상태라면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_2_3]</color> 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人并附加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_1]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>。（无视效果抵抗）\n若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，伤害增加并对同一目标使用<color=#28d9ed>额外攻击</color>。\n攻击后使自身<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000015_2_4]回合</color>内提升，若目标处于出血状态，自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000015_2_3]</color>。

desc.en: When using this skill, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000015_3_1]</color> chance to <color=#28d9ed>remove all</color> <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> from a target, then attacks that target.\nThe damage is increased if the target has been inflicted with <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color>.\nDetonates all <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> stacks on the target. Damage dealt by detonation increases by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.
desc.jp: スキル使用時、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000015_3_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>すべて解除</color>し、敵単体にダメージを与える。\n対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。対象が保有する<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>をすべて<color=#28d9ed>破裂</color>させ、破裂によるダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>UPする。

desc.zh: 使用技能时，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000015_3_1]</color>的概率解除目标<color=#28d9ed>所有强化效果</color>并攻击敌人。\n若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，伤害增加。\n使目标<color=#28d9ed>所有出血</color>全部<color=#28d9ed>爆发</color>，爆发造成的伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

(Stacks up to 3 times)

desc.kr: 스킬 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000019_3_1]턴</color> 동안 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>증가</color>시키고 적 전체를 공격합니다. \n<color=#28d9ed>도지기리 야스츠나</color>를 사용할 때마다 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000019_3_2]</color> 증가합니다. (최대 3회 누적)

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. Obtains <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_1_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>Kaizer Energy (Unique Resource)</color> if used during the caster's turn.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分のターンの場合<color=#28d9ed>【固有資源：カイザーエナジー】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_1_1]個</color>獲得する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 턴이라면 <color=#28d9ed>고유 자원 : 카이저 에너지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_1_1]개</color> 획득합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，若处于自身回合，则获得<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_1_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>固有资源：凯撒能量</color>。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) If <color=#28d9ed>Kaizer Knuckle</color> scores a critical hit during the caster's turn, activates <color=#28d9ed>Kaizer Cannon</color> as an additional attack. Attacks all enemies, dealing damage proportional to the target's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>. Obtains <color=#28d9ed>1</color> additional <color=#28d9ed>Kaizer Energy (Unique Resource)</color>.
desc.jp: (発動効果)自分のターンに<color=#28d9ed>【カイザーナックル】</color>で会心が発生した場合、追加で<color=#28d9ed>【カイザーキャノン】</color>を発動し、<color=#28d9ed>【固有資源：カイザーエナジー】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1個</color>獲得する。<color=#28d9ed>【カイザーキャノン】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 자신의 턴에 <color=#28d9ed>카이저 너클</color> 스킬이 치명 공격으로 적중하면 추가타로 <color=#28d9ed>카이저 캐논</color> 스킬을 발동합니다. 적 전체를 공격하고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다. <color=#28d9ed>고유 자원 : 카이저 에너지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 더 획득합니다.
desc.zh: (触发效果)若技能<color=#28d9ed>凯撒铁拳</color>在自身回合以暴击命中，则额外发动技能<color=#28d9ed>凯撒加农炮</color>。攻击全体敌人，目标的<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，则该技能的伤害越高。额外获得<color=#28d9ed>1个</color><color=#28d9ed>固有资源：凯撒能量</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. Increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000022_3_1] turn(s)</color>. When <color=#28d9ed>Kaizer Energy (Unique Resource)</color> owned is <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_3_2]</color>, consumes all to increase damage dealt proportional to the target's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000022_3_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。\n\n<color=#28d9ed>【固有資源：カイザーエナジー】</color>が<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_3_2]個</color>ある場合、すべて消費してダメージを与える。このダメージは対象の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000022_3_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다. <color=#28d9ed>고유 자원 : 카이저 에너지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_3_2]개</color> 보유 시, 모두 소모하여 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>에 비례하여 피해량이 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击所有敌人，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000022_3_1]回合</color>。当持有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000022_3_2]个</color><color=#28d9ed>固有资源：凯撒能量</color>时，消耗全部，并根据目标的<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>等比提升伤害量。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>debuff(s)</color> from all allies.\n Also heals the ally with the lowest Health for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color>の確率で味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]個</color>解除する。\nまた、残りHPが最も低い味方単体のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color>回復する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color> 확률로 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]개</color> 해제합니다.\n또한 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color> 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000023_1_1]</color>的几率解除全体友军<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_1]</color>个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。\n并恢复生命值最低友军<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_1_2]</color>生命值。

desc.en: Heals all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Health</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color> of Saeran's Max Health. Additionally, recovers all other allies' <color=#28d9ed>Action Points</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color>. Removes <color=#28d9ed>1</color><color=#28d9ed>Debuff</color>of all Earth allies including the caster and grants <color=#28d9ed>Sustained Recovery</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1</color> turn(s). (The amount of healing is proportional to the target's Max Health).
desc.jp: 味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を【セイラン】の最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color>回復させ、【セイラン】を除く味方全体が<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color>獲得する。\nまた、持続性味方の <color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1個</color>解除し、<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>継続回復</color>を付与する。（回復量は対象の最大HPが高いほどUP）
desc.kr:
아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 세이란 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color> 만큼 회복시키고, 세이란을 제외한 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>AP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color> 회복시킵니다.
그리고 모든 지속성 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 해제시키고, <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color>동안 <color=#28d9ed>지속 회복</color>을 걸어줍니다. (대상의 최대 체력에 비례하여 회복합니다.)
desc.zh: 使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复相当于萨伊蓝最大生命值<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_1]</color>，并使除萨伊蓝外的友军<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_2_2]</color>。\n同时为所有<color=#28d9ed>持续属性</color>友军解除1个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，并赋予<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color><color=#28d9ed>持续恢复</color>。（恢复量与目标最大生命值成比例）

desc.en: Heals one ally by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color> and reduces the target's <color=#28d9ed>Skill Cooldown</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]turns(s)</color>. Additionally, removes all of the target's <color=#28d9ed>Debuff</color> and increases the target's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color>. \nGrants <color=#28d9ed>Invulnerability</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Increase Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color> if the target is an Earth ally.
desc.jp: 味方単体のHPを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color>回復させた後、対象の<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]ターン</color>減少させる。また、対象のすべての<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を解除し、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color>UPさせる。\n地属性対象に<color=#28d9ed>無敵</color>と<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力UP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 아군 한 명의 체력을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color> 회복시킨 후, 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>스킬 쿨타임</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]턴</color> 감소시킵니다. 그리고 대상의 모든 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 해제하고 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n대상이 지속성인 경우 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>무적</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color> 증가를 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 使1名友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_1]</color>，并减少目标的<color=#28d9ed>技能冷却时间</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_2]</color>回合。\n解除目标的全部<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，并提升其<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000023_3_3]</color>。\n若目标为<color=#28d9ed>持续属性</color>友军，则赋予<color=#28d9ed>无敌</color>与<color=#28d9ed>攻击力提升</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000025_1_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000025_1_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.\n대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 대상 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000025_1_2]</color> 만큼 고정 피해를 입힙니다.

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) Activates an <color=#28d9ed>Agile Response</color> effect when an ally is inflicted with a <color=#28d9ed>debuff</color>.\nRemoves <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_2]</color> <color=#28d9ed>debuff(s)</color> from all allies and <color=#28d9ed>Heals</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_3]</color>.
desc.jp: (発動効果)味方に<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>【迅速対応】</color>を発動する。\n【迅速対応】：味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_2]個</color>解除し、<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_3]</color>回復させる。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 아군에게 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color> 적용 시 <color=#28d9ed>신속 대응</color> 효과가 발동합니다.\n아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_2]</color>개 해제하고 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_3]</color> 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: (触发效果)友军获得<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>时，将发动<color=#28d9ed>迅速应对</color>效果。\n解除全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_2]</color>个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>，并使<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_2_3]</color>。

desc.en: <color=#28d9ed>Heals</color> selected ally by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_3_1]</color> and increases the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000036_3_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 味方単体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_3_1]</color>回復させ、<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000036_3_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。
desc.kr: 선택한 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_3_1]</color> 회복시키고, <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000036_3_2]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 使所选友军的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000036_3_1]</color>，并使<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000036_3_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_1_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Taunted</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_1_1] turn(s)</color>. Activates a <color=#28d9ed>Dual Attack</color> from the ally with the highest Attack if the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> is currently increased.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_1_1]</color>の確率で対象を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_1_1]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>挑発</color>する。自分の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>がUPした状態の場合、攻撃力が最も高い味方単体に<color=#28d9ed>連携</color>を発生させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_1_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>도발</color>합니다. 자신이 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 증가한 상태라면 가장 공격력이 높은 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>협공</color>을 발생시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_1_1]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>挑衅</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_1_1]回合</color>。若自身<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>处于提升状态，则使攻击力最高的友军发动<color=#28d9ed>夹攻</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_2_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>debuff(s)</color> from the caster at the start of the turn. Grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the ally with the lowest Health for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_2_2] turn(s)</color>. The Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)ターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_2_1]個</color>解除する。その後、残りHPが最も低い味方単体に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどシールド量がUPする。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과) 턴 시작 시 자신에게 걸려 있는 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_2_1]</color>개 제거합니다. 이후 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군에게 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_2_2]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다. 실드량은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 증가합니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果)在回合开始时，解除自身附带的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_2_1]</color>个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。此后使生命值最低的友军获得<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_2_2]回合</color>。自身的<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，则护盾量越高。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and increases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>DEF</color> and your <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_3_1]</color> turns.\nAfter attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_3_3]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_3_3]</color> buff(s) from all enemies.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と自分の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_3_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。\n攻撃後、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_3_3]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_3_3]</color>個解除する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>과 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_3_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.\n공격 후, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_3_3]</color> 확률로 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_3_3]</color>개 제거합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000037_3_1]</color>回合内提高我方全体<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>与自身<color=#28d9ed>效果命中</color>。\n攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000037_3_3]</color>的几率驱散敌方全体<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000037_3_3]</color>个增益效果。

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700037_1_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Taunted</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_1_1] turn(s)</color>.

This skill's damage increases proportional to Max Health instead of Attack.

desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700037_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_1_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>도발</color> 하며, 가장 공격력이 높은 아군의 협공을 발생시킵니다.\n자신의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 증가한 상태라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700037_1_3]</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_1_3]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.\n이 스킬은 공격력 대신 최대 체력에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.

desc.en:
(Passive Effect) At the start of the turn, removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_2_2] debuff(s)</color> each from the ally with the lowest Health and from the caster.
Then grants a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color> to the ally with the lowest Health for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_4] turn(s)</color>. The Barrier strength increases proportional to the caster's Max Health.

(Activation Effect) After being hit, uses <color=#28d9ed>Sword Destroyer</color> on the enemy with the highest Speed and has an <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700037_2_5]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Taunted</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_5] turn(s)</color>.
This skill's damage increases proportional to Max Health instead of Attack.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
ターン開始後、残りHPが最も低い味方単体と自分の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>をそれぞれ<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_2_2]</color>個解除する。
その後、残りHPが最も低い味方単体に <color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_4]ターン</color>の間付与する。
自分の最大HPが高いほどシールド量がUPする。

(パッシブ効果) ダメージを受けた後、最もスピードが高い敵単体に<color=#28d9ed>ソード・デストロイア</color>を使用して, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700037_2_5]</color>の確率で対象を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_5]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>挑発</color>する。
このスキルは攻撃力の代わりに最大HPが高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과) 턴 시작 시, 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군과 자신에게 걸려 있는 <color=#28d9ed>약화</color> 효과를 각각 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_2_2]개</color> 해제합니다.
이후 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군에게 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_4]턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
실드량은 자신의 최대 체력이 높을수록 증가합니다.

(발동 효과) 피격 후, 가장 속도가 빠른 적에게 <color=#28d9ed>소드 디스트로이어</color>를 사용하며, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700037_2_5]</color> 확률로 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_5]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>도발</color> 합니다.
이 스킬은 공격력 대신 최대 체력에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
（被动效果）回合开始时，解除生命值状况最差的友军与自身身上的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_2_2]</color>个<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>。
随后为生命值状况最差的友军赋予<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_4]</color>回合。
护盾量随施术者的最大生命值提高而增加。

（触发效果）受到攻击后，对速度最快的敌人使用<color=#28d9ed>剑之毁灭者</color>，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700037_2_5]</color>的几率使目标陷入<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_2_5]</color>回合的<color=#28d9ed>嘲讽</color>状态。
此技能造成的伤害与最大生命值成正比，而非攻击力。

desc.en:
Removes <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_3_1] buff(s)</color> from all enemies, then attacks all enemies. (Ignores Resilience)
After attacking, increases <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> of all allies and the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Effectiveness</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_3_2] turn(s)</color>.
If the target is a Boss, ignores 30% of their Defense.
This skill's damage increases proportional to Max Health instead of Attack.
desc.jp:
敵全体の強化効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_3_1]個</color>解除した後、ダメージを与える。(効果抵抗無視)
攻撃後、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と自分の<color=#28d9ed>効果命中</color>を <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_3_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。
対象がボスの場合、防御力を30%無視する。
このスキルは攻撃力の代わりに最大HPが高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr:
적 전체의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_3_1]개</color> 해제 후 적 전체를 공격합니다.(효과 저항 무시)
공격 후 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>과 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 적중</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_3_2]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
대상이 보스인 경우 방어력을 30% 무시합니다.
이 스킬은 공격력 대신 최대 체력에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
解除全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700037_3_1]</color>个<color=#28d9ed>增益效果</color>后攻击全体敌人。（无视效果抵抗）
攻击后，使我方全体<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>与自身<color=#28d9ed>效果命中</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700037_3_2]</color>回合。
若目标为首领，则无视其30%的防御力。
此技能造成的伤害与最大生命值成正比，而非攻击力。

desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_1_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_1_1]</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks 2 enemies.\nHas a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_2_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000043_2_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>Buffs</color> from the target and inflict <color=#28d9ed>Burn</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2] turn(s)</color>.\nIf the target is Earth Element, this attack does not miss and decreases <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵2体にダメージを与える。\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_2_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000043_2_1]つ</color>解除し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>火傷</color>を付与する。\n対象が地属性の場合、ミスが発生せず<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_2_1]</color>의 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000043_2_1]개</color> 해제하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>화상</color> 상태로 만듭니다.\n대상이 지속성이라면 빗나감이 발생하지 않으며 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人。\n有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_2_1]</color>的概率解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000043_2_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，并造成<color=#28d9ed>烧伤</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]回合</color>。\n若目标为地属性，则不会发生闪避，并使<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_2_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks 2 enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_1]</color> chance to decrease <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> of all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAdditionally, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unhealable</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_3] turn(s)</color>.\nIf the target is Earth Element, this attack does not miss.
desc.jp: 敵2体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_1]ターン</color>の間、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>をDOWNさせる。\nさらに<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_3]</color>の確率で敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_3]ターン</color>の間<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を付与する。\n対象が地属性の場合、ミスが発生しない。
desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_1]턴</color> 동안 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>속도</color>를 감소시킵니다.\n추가로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_3]</color> 확률로 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>회복 불가</color>를 부여합니다.\n대상이 지속성이라면 빗나감이 발생하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 攻击2名敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_1]</color>的概率使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_1]回合</color>。\n此外，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000043_3_3]</color>的概率对全体敌人施加<color=#28d9ed>无法恢复</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000043_3_3]回合</color>。\n若目标为地属性，则不会发生闪避。

desc.en:
Attacks 2 enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700043_3_1]</color> chance to decrease all enemies' <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700043_3_1] turns</color>.
Additionally, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700043_3_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unhealable</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700043_3_3] turns</color> and decreases the Priority of the enemy with the highest Attack by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>.

If the target is Earth type, Miss will not occur.
desc.jp:
敵2体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700043_3_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700043_3_1]ターン</color>の間、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>をDOWNさせる。
さらに<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700043_3_3]</color>の確率で敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>回復不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700043_3_3]ターン</color>の間付与し、攻撃力が最も高い敵の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>DOWNさせる。

또한 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700043_3_3]</color> 확률로 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700043_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>회복 불가</color>를 부여하고 공격력이 가장 높은 적의 행동 게이지를 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> 감소시킵니다.

대상이 지속성이라면 빗나감이 발생하지 않습니다.
desc.zh:
攻击2名敌人，以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700043_3_1]</color>的概率使全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>速度</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700043_3_1]回合</color>。
此外以<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2700043_3_3]</color>的概率对全体敌人附加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700043_3_3]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>无法恢复</color>，并使攻击力最高的敌人行动值降低<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。

若目标为土属性，则不发生<color=#28d9ed>闪避</color>。

또한 보스가 아닌 대상의 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>2%</color> 이하인 경우 <color=#28d9ed>즉사</color>시키며 이 때 <color=#28d9ed>불사</color> 효과는 무시됩니다.

desc.zh:
攻击所有敌人。
若为自身的回合，则获得<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_1_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>固有资源：统治欲</color>。
此技能造成的伤害会随自身的<color=#28d9ed>最大生命值</color>提升而增加，并无视目标<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。
当非<color=#28d9ed>首领怪物</color>的目标生命值低于<color=#28d9ed>2%</color>时，触发<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>效果，并无视<color=#28d9ed>不死</color>状态。
对<color=#28d9ed>首领怪物</color>造成更高伤害。

desc.en:
(Passive Effect) Unaffected by <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color>, <color=#28d9ed>Petrified</color>, and <color=#28d9ed>Priority Decrease</color> effects, and reduces damage taken from single-target attacks by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_1]</color>.
At the start of battle, grants <color=#28d9ed>Selfish God</color> to the caster.
(Activation Effect) Prepares the <color=#28d9ed>Revenge</color> effect for each <color=#28d9ed>Cooldown</color> of the skill.
When <color=#28d9ed>Revenge</color> activates, attacks all enemies and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_3]</color>. This skill's damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color>.
desc.jp:
(パッシブ効果)<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>、<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>、<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>、<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージDOWN</color>の影響を受けず、単体攻撃で受けるダメージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_1]</color>DOWNさせる。
戦闘開始時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>身勝手な神</color>を付与する。
(パッシブ効果)<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>ごとに<color=#28d9ed>【復讐】</color>を発動する。
<color=#28d9ed>【復讐】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、自分の行動ゲージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_3]</color>UPする。このスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color>, <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>, <color=#28d9ed>석화</color>, <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지 감소</color>의 영향을 받지 않고, 단일 공격으로 받는 피해를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_1]</color> 감소시킵니다.
전투 시작 시, 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>이기적인 신</color>을 부여합니다.
(발동 효과) 스킬의 <color=#28d9ed>쿨타임</color>마다 <color=#28d9ed>복수</color> 효과를 준비합니다.
<color=#28d9ed>복수</color> 발동 시 적 전체를 공격하고 자신의 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_3]</color> 증가합니다. 이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
(被动效果)不受<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>、<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>、<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>、<color=#28d9ed>行动值降低</color>效果的影响，并使因单体攻击受到的伤害降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_1]</color>。
战斗开始时，为自身赋予<color=#28d9ed>自私之神</color>。
(触发效果)每当技能处于<color=#28d9ed>冷却时间</color>时，<color=#28d9ed>复仇</color>效果待触发。
<color=#28d9ed>复仇</color>效果生效时，攻击全体敌人，并使自身行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000053_2_3]</color>。自身<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>越高，则该技能的伤害越高。

desc.en:
<color=#28d9ed>Requires [Buff_V_2000053_3_1] Desire for Control (Unique Resource) to use this skill.</color>
Attacks all enemies and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Petrify</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000053_3_3] turn(s)</color>. The <color=#28d9ed>Petrify</color> effect ignores <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color>.
This skill's damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> and ignores <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> of the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.
Additionally, instantly kills non-Boss enemies with <color=#28d9ed>2%</color> or less <color=#28d9ed>Health</color>, ignoring <color=#28d9ed>Immortality</color>.
Deals greater damage to <color=#28d9ed>Bosses</color> and ignores <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> of their <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.

このスキルは<color=#28d9ed>【固有資源：支配欲】が[Buff_V_2000053_3_1]個ある場合、使用できる。</color>
敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000053_3_3]ターン</color>の間付与する。石化は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。
このスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPし、対象の防御力を <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>無視する。
また、ボスではない対象のHPが<color=#28d9ed>2%</color> 以下の場合、<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>効果を与え、その際<color=#28d9ed>不死</color> 効果を無視する.
対象がボスの場合、より大ダメージを与え、防御力を <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>無視する。
desc.kr:
<color=#28d9ed>고유 자원 : 지배욕 [Buff_V_2000053_3_1]개 보유 시 사용 가능합니다.</color>
적 전체를 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000053_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>석화</color>를 부여합니다. 석화 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.
이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가하고, 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 무시합니다.
또한 보스가 아닌 대상의 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>2%</color> 이하인 경우 <color=#28d9ed>즉사</color>시키며 이 때 <color=#28d9ed>불사</color> 효과는 무시됩니다.
대상이 보스인 경우 더 큰 피해를 입히고 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 무시합니다.

攻击所有敌人，并在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000053_3_3]</color>回合内施加<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>效果。
<color=#28d9ed>石化</color>效果无视目标的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>。
此技能的伤害随自身的<color=#28d9ed>最大生命值</color>提升而增加，并无视目标<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。
当非<color=#28d9ed>首领怪物</color>的目标生命值低于<color=#28d9ed>2%</color>时，触发<color=#28d9ed>即死</color>效果，并无视<color=#28d9ed>不死</color>状态。
对<color=#28d9ed>首领怪物</color>造成更高伤害，并无视其<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。

desc.kr: 피해 증가\n방어력 증가 +2턴
desc.zh: 伤害提升\n2回合内提升防御力

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and <color=#28d9ed>heals</color> the ally with the lowest Health by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_1_1]</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、残りHPが最も低い味方単体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_1_1]</color>回復する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 체력 상황이 가장 나쁜 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_1_1]</color> 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使生命值最低的友军恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_1_1]</color>的<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>。

desc.en: Restores all allies' <color=#28d9ed>HP</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_2_1]</color> and reduces the duration of debuffs by <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
desc.jp: 味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_2_1]</color>回復し、弱体効果の持続時間を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_2_1]</color>만큼 회복시키고, 약화 효과의 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 为我方全体恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_2_1]</color><color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>，并将减益效果的持续时间缩短<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。

desc.en: Grants increased <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> to surviving allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000054_3_3] turn(s)</color>, then <color=#28d9ed>Resurrects (Greater)</color> all slain allies. Afterward, <color=#28d9ed>heals</color> all allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_3_2]</color>.
desc.jp: 戦場にいる味方の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000054_3_3]ターン</color>の間UPさせた後、倒れた味方全体を<color=#28d9ed>復活(強化)</color>させる。その後、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_3_2]</color>回復させる。
desc.kr: 생존한 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000054_3_3]턴</color> 동안 증가시킨 후, 사망한 아군 전체를 <color=#28d9ed>부활(강화)</color>시킵니다. 이후 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_3_2]</color>만큼 회복시킵니다.
desc.zh: 使存活的友军<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000054_3_3]回合</color>后，使死亡的全体友军<color=#28d9ed>复活(强化)</color>。随后使全体友军<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000054_3_2]</color>。

desc.en: Effects are applied to all allies
desc.jp: 味方全体に効果適用
desc.kr: 아군 전체에게 효과 적용
desc.zh: 对全体友军发动效果

desc.en: +70 Action Points to Target
desc.jp: 対象のAP+70
desc.kr: 대상 AP +70
desc.zh: 目标AP+70

desc.jp: 回復強化（回復量）\n弱体効果持続 −2ターン
desc.kr: 회복 강화(회복량)\n약화 효과 지속 -2턴
desc.zh: 恢复强化（恢复量）\n减益持续 −2回合

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000055_1]</color> chance to grant the caster increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000055_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000055_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000055_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000055_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000055_1]턴</color> 동안 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000055_1]</color>的几率使自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000055_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: When using this skill, <color=#28d9ed>removes all</color> <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> on the target and attacks the enemy. If the caster is granted increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color>, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000055_2_1]</color>. This attack bypasses the target's Resilience.
desc.jp: スキル使用時、敵単体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>すべて解除</color>し、ダメージを与える。自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>がUPした状態の場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000055_2_1]</color>UPさせる。この攻撃は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。
desc.kr: 스킬 사용 시 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>모두 해제</color>하고 적을 공격합니다. 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 증가한 상태라면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000055_2_1]</color> 증가시킵니다. 이 공격은 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.
desc.zh: 使用技能时，使目标的<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color><color=#28d9ed>全部解除</color>并攻击敌人。若自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>处于提升状态，则使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000055_2_1]</color>。该攻击无视目标的效果抵抗。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. Increases damage dealt to enemies with <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color>.\nWhen the enemy has no <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color> or is defeated after this skill is used, grants an <color=#28d9ed>extra turn</color>.\nThis skill deals increased damage to Earth bosses.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。対象に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がある場合、与えるダメージがUPする。\nスキル使用後、対象に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がない、または敵が倒れた場合、<color=#28d9ed>追加ターン</color>を獲得する。\nこのスキルは地属性のボスに与えるダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 보유한 적에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.\n스킬 사용 후 대상에게 적용된 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>가 없거나, 적이 처치된 경우 <color=#28d9ed>추가 턴</color>을 획득합니다.\n이 스킬은 지속성 보스에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人。对附带<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>敌人造成的伤害
提升。
使用技能后，若目标未附带<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，或击杀敌人，则获得<color=#28d9ed>额外回合</color>。
该技能对土属性首领造成的伤害提升。

desc.en: Increases damage (Additional increase against Earth enemies)
desc.jp: ダメージUP\n(地属性の敵には\n追加でダメージUP)
desc.kr: 피해 증가 (지속성 적에게는 추가로 피해 증가)
desc.zh: 伤害提升\n(对土属性敌人造成的额外伤害提升)

desc.jp: ダメージUP
desc.kr: 피해 증가
desc.zh: 伤害提升

desc.en: Changed to Enhanced Attack\nResets Gone Surfing! cooldown
desc.jp: 強化攻撃に変更\n【ハデに決めちゃうし!】\nスキルターン初期化
desc.kr: 강화 공격으로 교체\n다들 서핑하러 갔대! 쿨타임 초기화
desc.zh: 替换为强化攻击\n大家都去冲浪了！的冷却时间重置

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>.\nIf the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color>, the effect is applied to <color=#28d9ed>all allies</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>UPさせる。\n<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>味方全体</color>の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>をUPさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 <color=#28d9ed>아군 전체</color>에게 효과가 적용됩니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_1_1]</color>。\n附带<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果时，将对<color=#28d9ed>全体友军</color>生效。

desc.en:
(Triggered Effect) Activates <color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color> when an ally lands a debuff on their turn.

<color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color>: Attacks all enemies, and inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
If the caster has <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color>, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2] turn(s)</color>. If the target is a <color=#28d9ed>Healer</color>, additionally inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color>.
desc.jp:
(発動効果)味方が自分のターンで敵に弱体効果を付与した場合、<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>を使用する。

<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、対象の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。対象が<color=#28d9ed>回復型</color>の場合、追加で<color=#28d9ed>沈黙</color>を付与する。
desc.kr:
(발동 효과) 아군 팀이 자신의 턴에 적에게 약화 효과 적중 시 <color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color>를 사용합니다.

<color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color> : 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 대상 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 감소시킵니다.
<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다. 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>회복형</color>이라면 추가적으로 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh:
(触发效果)友军在自身回合对敌人造成弱化效果时，使用<color=#28d9ed>晶体风暴</color>。

<color=#28d9ed>晶体风暴</color>：攻击全体敌人，并使全体目标的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]回合</color>。
附带<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果时，对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_2_2]回合</color>。若目标为<color=#28d9ed>恢复型</color>，则额外造成<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>效果。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>, and grants <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>UPさせ、<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]ターン</color>の間獲得する。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color> 증가시키고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color>를 획득합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000056_3_2]</color>，并获得<color=#28d9ed>猛烈攻势</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000056_3_1]回合</color>。

desc.jp: 【アースエッジ】+1ターン\n攻撃対象に中毒+2ターン
desc.kr: 매서운 공세 +1턴\n공격 대상에게 중독 +2턴
desc.zh: 猛烈攻势+1回合\n对攻击目标造成中毒+2回合

desc.jp: 強化攻撃に変更\n攻撃範囲拡大およびダメージUP
desc.kr: 강화 공격으로 교체\n공격 범위 확대 및 피해 증가
desc.zh: 替换为强化攻击\n扩大攻击范围，且伤害提升

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700056_1_1]</color>.\nIf <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color> is active, the effect applies to <color=#28d9ed>all allies</color> and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_1_2] turns</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700056_1_1]</color>UPさせる。\n<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>味方全体</color>に効果を付与し、対象に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_1_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700056_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 <color=#28d9ed>아군 전체</color>에게 효과가 적용되고 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_1_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人并使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2700056_1_1]</color>。\n拥有<color=#28d9ed>凌厉攻势</color>时，效果将作用于<color=#28d9ed>我方全体</color>，并对目标附加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_1_2]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>。

desc.en:
(Trigger Effect) When the ally team lands a debuff on an enemy during their turn, uses <color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color>.
(If the debuff is stackable, applies only once on the first stack.)

<color=#28d9ed>Crystal Storm</color> : Attacks all enemies and reduces all targets' <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_2_2] turns</color>.
If <color=#28d9ed>Fierce Offensive</color> is active, additionally inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Poisoned</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_2_2] turns</color>, and inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Silence</color> if the target is a <color=#28d9ed>healer</color>.
desc.jp:
(発動効果)味方が自分のターンで敵に弱体効果を付与した場合、<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>を使用する。
(累積効果の場合初回1回のみ適用)

<color=#28d9ed>【大地の烈斬】</color>：敵全体にダメージを与え、対象全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせ<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を付与する。
<color=#28d9ed>【アースエッジ】</color>がある場合、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>中毒</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_2_2]ターン</color>の間追加で付与する。対象が<color=#28d9ed>回復型</color>の場合、追加で<color=#28d9ed>沈黙</color>を付与する。
desc.kr:
(발동 효과) 아군 팀이 자신의 턴에 적에게 약화 효과 적중 시 <color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color>를 사용합니다.
(누적되는 효과인 경우 최초 1회만 적용)

<color=#28d9ed>결정 쇄도</color> : 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 대상 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 감소시키고 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 부여합니다.
<color=#28d9ed>매서운 공세</color> 보유 시 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2700056_2_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>중독</color>을 추가 부여하고 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>회복형</color>이라면 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh:
(发动效果) 我方队伍在自身回合对敌人命中弱化效果时，使用<color=#28d9ed>晶体风暴</color>。

desc.en: Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color> chance to grant all allies increased <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1] turn(s)</color>, before attacking an enemy.\nWhen scoring a critical hit, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Silenced</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color>の確率で、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1]ターン</color>の間UPさせた後、敵単体にダメージを与える。\nこのスキルで会心が発生した場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color>の確率で、対象に<color=#28d9ed>沈黙</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。
desc.kr: <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 증가시킨 후 적을 공격합니다.\n치명 공격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2]턴</color> 동안 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>침묵</color>을 부여합니다.
desc.zh: 有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_1]</color>的几率使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_1]回合</color>后，攻击敌人。 \n触发暴击时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_2_2]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>沉默</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_2_2]回合</color>。

desc.en:
Attacks all enemies. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2] turn(s)</color>.
When scoring a critical hit on one or more enemies, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color> chance to increase the <color=#28d9ed>skill cooldowns</color> of all targets by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>.

When attacking an <color=#ffd732>Irregular Monster</color>, increases <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> of all allies by <color=#28d9ed>3%</color> (Max 5 stacks).
desc.jp:
敵全体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color>の確率で、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
このスキルで会心が発生した場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color>の確率で、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スキルターン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>UPさせる。

 <color=#ffd732>イレギュラーモンスター</color>を攻撃時、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>3%</color>UPさせる。(最大5回累積)
desc.kr:
적 전체를 공격합니다. <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2]턴</color> 동안 대상 모두의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 감소시킵니다.
한 명 이상의 적에게 치명 공격 시 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color> 확률로 대상 모두의 <color=#28d9ed>스킬 쿨타임</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 증가시킵니다. 


<color=#ffd732>이레귤러 몬스터</color> 공격 시 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>3%</color> 증가시킵니다. (최대 5회 누적)
desc.zh:
攻击全体敌人。有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_2]</color>的几率使全体目标的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000060_3_2]回合</color>。
对1名以上的敌人触发暴击时，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000060_3_1]</color>的几率使全体目标的<color=#28d9ed>技能冷却时间</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

攻击<color=#ffd732>异型怪</color>时，使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>3%</color>(最多叠加5次)。

desc.en: +3 turns increased Critical Damage on allies
desc.jp: 会心ダメージUP+3ターン\n(味方全体)
desc.kr: 아군 팀 치명 피해 증가 +3턴
desc.zh: 友军暴击伤害提升+3回合

desc.en: +3 turns increased Effectiveness on allies
desc.jp: 効果命中UP+3ターン\n(味方全体)
desc.kr: 아군 전체 효과 적중 증가 +3턴
desc.zh: 全体友军效果命中提升+3回合

desc.en: Gains an extra turn
desc.jp: 追加ターン発生
desc.kr: 추가 턴 발생
desc.zh: 触发额外回合

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. After attacking, if the enemy has no <color=#28d9ed>buffs</color>, increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color>. If the enemy has a <color=#28d9ed>buff</color>, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color> chance to remove <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]</color> <color=#28d9ed>buff(s)</color> from the target.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、対象に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がない場合、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color>UPさせる。対象に<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>がある場合、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]個</color>解除する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>가 없다면 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color> 증가시킵니다. <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 보유하고 있다면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]개</color> 해제합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，若目标没有<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，则使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_2]</color>。若附带<color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>，则有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_1_1]</color>的几率解除目标的<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_1_1]个</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Decreases <color=#28d9ed>Damage Taken</color> by allies (excluding self) by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color> and further decreases <color=#28d9ed>Damage Taken</color> by Fire allies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>.\n\n(Triggered Effect) When an enemy uses a <color=#28d9ed>non-attack skill</color>, activates an <color=#28d9ed>Agile Response</color>. Reduces duration of buffs on all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>1 turn</color>, increases <color=#28d9ed>Attack and Defense</color> of all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2] turn(s)</color>, and increases the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)自分を除く味方の<color=#28d9ed>受けるダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color>減少させ、火属性の味方の<color=#28d9ed>受けるダメージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>追加で減少させる。\n\n(パッシブ効果)敵が<color=#28d9ed>攻撃以外のスキル</color>を使用時、<color=#28d9ed>【迅速対応】</color>を発動する。敵全体の強化効果持続時間を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>減少させ、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせた後、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr:
(패시브 효과) 자신을 제외한 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>받는 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color>만큼 감소시키고 화속성 아군의 <color=#28d9ed>받는 피해</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>만큼 추가로 감소시킵니다.


(발동 효과) 적이 <color=#28d9ed>공격이 아닌 스킬</color> 사용 시 <color=#28d9ed>신속 대응</color> 효과가 발동합니다.
적 전체의 강화 효과 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 감소시키고
아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2]턴</color> 동안 증가시킨 뒤, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>만큼 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: (被动效果) 使除自身外的友军<color=#28d9ed>所受伤害</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_5]</color>，且使火属性友军的<color=#28d9ed>所受伤害</color>额外降低<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_6]</color>。\n\n(触发效果) 敌人使用<color=#28d9ed>非攻击类技能</color>时，触发<color=#28d9ed>迅速应对</color>效果。使全体敌人的强化效果持续时间减少<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>，并在使全体友军的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_2_2]回合</color>后，使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000061_2_4]</color>。

desc.en: Before using skill, removes <color=#28d9ed>1</color> buff from all enemies and attacks all enemies. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> on all targets for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1] turn(s)</color>. Enemy cannot Counterattack, Revenge, or use Agile Response immediately after this skill.
desc.jp: スキル使用前、敵全体の強化効果を<color=#28d9ed>1個</color>解除して敵全体にダメージを与える。対象全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。このスキル直後には敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
desc.kr:
스킬 사용 전 적 전체의 강화 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 해제하고
적 전체를 공격합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color> 확률로 대상 모두에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 施展技能前，解除全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>1个</color>强化效果并攻击全体敌人。有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000061_3_1]</color>的几率对所有目标造成<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000061_3_1]回合</color>。此技能施展后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇及迅速应对。

desc.en: Increases Effect Hit Rate for 3 turns before attacking.
desc.jp: 攻撃前、効果命中UP +3ターン
desc.kr: 공격 전 효과 적중 증가 +3턴
desc.zh: 攻击前，效果命中提升，持续3回合。

desc.en: Activates Dual Attack with 1 ally
desc.jp: 連携1体発生
desc.kr: 아군 1명 협공 호출
desc.zh: 呼叫1名友军发动夹攻

desc.en: -2 turns on all skill cooldowns
desc.jp: すべてのスキルターン-2ターン
desc.kr: 모든 스킬 쿨타임 -2턴
desc.zh: 所有技能的冷却时间-2回合

desc.en: Attacks an enemy. This attack deals increased damage proportional to the number of <color=#28d9ed>debuffs</color> on the target.\nHas a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_1_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_1_2] turn(s)</color>. This effect ignores the target's Resilience.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。このスキルは対象の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果</color>の数が多いほど、与えるダメージがUPする。\n対象に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_1_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_1_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다. 이 공격은 대상이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과</color>가 많을수록 피해가 증가합니다.\n대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_1_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_1_2]턴</color> 동안 지속되는 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>를 부여합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。目标附带的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果</color>越多，则该技能的伤害越高。\n有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_1_2]</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_1_2]回合</color>。该效果无视目标的效果抵抗。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy.\nInflicts <color=#28d9ed>Cursed</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_2_1] turn(s)</color>. This effect ignores the target's Resilience.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。\n対象に<color=#28d9ed>呪い</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다.\n대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_2_1]턴</color> 동안 지속되는 <color=#28d9ed>저주</color>를 부여합니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。\n对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>诅咒</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_2_1]回合</color>。该效果无视目标的效果抵抗。\n此技能发动后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_3_1]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_3_1] turn(s)</color>. This effect ignores the target's Resilience.\nThis attack deals increased damage proportional to the number of <color=#28d9ed>buffs and debuffs</color> on the target.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_3_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_3_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。この効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。\nこのスキルは対象の<color=#28d9ed>弱体効果と強化効果</color>の数が多いほど、与えるダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_3_1]</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_3_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다. 이 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.\n이 공격은 대상이 보유한 <color=#28d9ed>약화 효과와 강화 효과</color>가 많을수록 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000062_3_1]</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000062_3_1]回合</color>。该效果无视目标的效果抵抗。\n目标附带的<color=#28d9ed>弱化效果和强化效果</color>越多，则该技能的伤害越高。

desc.en: +2 turns Reduced Critical Hit Chance duration
desc.jp: 対象の会心率DOWN+2ターン
desc.kr: 대상 치명 확률 감소 +2턴
desc.zh: 目标暴击率降低+2回合

desc.en: +1 Weakness Gauge damage
desc.jp: WGダメージ+1
desc.kr: WG 감소량 +1
desc.zh: WG降低量+1

desc.en: Changed to Enhanced Attack\nIncreased damage (Additional increased damage dealt to Dark element enemies)
desc.jp: 強化攻撃に変更\nダメージUP(闇属性の敵には\n追加でダメージUP)
desc.kr: 강화 공격으로 교체\n피해 증가 (암속성 적에게는 추가로 피해 증가)
desc.zh: 替换为强化攻击\n伤害提升(对暗属性敌人\n造成的额外伤害提升)

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and deals <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000063_1_2]</color> of the target's Max Health as fixed damage.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> instead of Attack.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象の最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000063_1_2]</color>の固定ダメージを与える。\nこのスキルは攻撃力の代わりに<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고, 대상 최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000063_1_2]</color> 만큼 고정 피해를 입힙니다.\n이 스킬은 공격력 대신 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>에 비례하여 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人，并使其受到相当于目标生命值上限
<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000063_1_2]</color>的固定伤害。
该技能根据<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>而非攻击力等比提升
伤害。

desc.en: Grants <color=#28d9ed>Show Your Loyalty</color> to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1] turn(s)</color> and grants a <color=#28d9ed>Shield</color> to all allies except the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1] turn(s)</color>. Shield strength increases proportional to the caster's Max Health.\nIncreases all allies' <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_4] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 自分に<color=#28d9ed>【忠義をみせろ】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与し、自分を除く味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。\n自分の最大HPが高いほどシールド量がUPする。\n味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>と<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_4]ターン</color>の間UPさせる。
desc.kr: 자신에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>충의를 보여라</color>를 부여하고 자신을 제외한 아군 전체에 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 부여합니다. 실드량은 자신의 최대 체력에 비례하여 증가합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_4]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>관통력</color>과 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 증가시킵니다.
desc.zh: 对自身附加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>表明你的忠心吧</color>，并对除自身外的我方全体附加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_1]回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>。护盾量按自身最大生命值比例增加。\n使我方全体<color=#28d9ed>穿透力</color>和<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>在<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000063_2_4]回合</color>内提升。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to <color=#28d9ed>Max Health</color> instead of Attack, and ignores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color>.\nEnemies killed by this skill cannot be Resurrected or Revived.
desc.jp:
敵単体にダメージを与える。
このスキルは攻撃力の代わりに<color=#28d9ed>最大HP</color>が高いほどダメージがUPし、
対象の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>30％</color>無視する。
このスキルで倒れた敵は復活と蘇生ができなくなる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격합니다.\n이 스킬은 공격력 대신 <color=#28d9ed>최대 체력</color>에 비례하여 피해가 증가하고 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> 무시합니다.\n이 스킬로 사망한 적은 부활 및 소생이 불가능합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人。\n该技能伤害按<color=#28d9ed>生命值上限</color>而非攻击力计算，并无视目标<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>。\n通过该技能击杀的敌人无法复活及苏生。

desc.en: Increases Penetration by 30%
desc.jp: 貫通力+30%
desc.kr: 관통력 30% 증가
desc.zh: 穿透力提升30%

desc.en: Damage dealt increases proportional to missing Health\nAll defeated enemies unable to Resurrect or Revive
desc.jp: 対象の残りHPが低いほどダメージUP\n倒れた敵の復活及び蘇生不可
desc.kr: 잃은 체력에 비례하여 피해 증가\n사망한 적 부활 및 소생 불가
desc.zh: 已损失生命值越多，伤害越高\n被击败的敌人无法复活或复生

desc.en: Changed to Enhanced Attack\nResets cooldown of Dragon Ruler's Breath
desc.jp: 強化攻撃に変更\n【竜王の息吹】スキルターン初期化
desc.kr: 강화 공격으로 교체\n용왕의 숨결 쿨타임 초기화
desc.zh: 替换为强化攻击\n重置龙王吐息冷却时间

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color> chance to inflict reduced <color=#28d9ed>Attack</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>攻撃力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color>의 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>공격력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_1_1]</color>的几率降低目标的<color=#28d9ed>攻击力</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies. After attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color> chance to increase the duration of debuffs on the enemy by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1] turn(s)</color>, then inflicts reduced <color=#28d9ed>Resilience</color> on targets without debuffs for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>の確率で敵の弱体効果を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]ターン</color>の間増加させ、弱体効果がない対象の<color=#28d9ed>効果抵抗</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>의 확률로 적이 보유한 약화 효과의 지속 시간을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]턴</color> 증가시킨 후, 약화 효과가 없는 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>효과 저항</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_2_1]</color>的几率使敌人附带的弱化效果持续时间增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_2_1]回合</color>，使未附带弱化效果目标的<color=#28d9ed>效果抵抗</color>降低，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_2_2]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies, and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Unbuffable</color> and <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Defense</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color> chance to avoid triggering an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>強化不可</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与し、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color>の確率で敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color>의 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]턴</color> 동안 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>강화 불가</color>와 <color=#28d9ed>방어력 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color>의 확률로 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않습니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000064_3_2]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>无法强化</color>与<color=#28d9ed>防御力降低</color>效果，持续 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000064_3_2]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000064_3_1]</color>的几率不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果。

desc.en: +1 turn reduced Critical Hit Chance on target
desc.jp: 会心率DOWN+1ターン
desc.kr: 대상 치명 확률 감소 +1턴
desc.zh: 目标暴击率降低+1回合

desc.en: +1 turn Unbuffable on target
desc.jp: 強化不可+1ターン
desc.kr: 대상 강화 불가 +1턴
desc.zh: 目标无法强化+1回合

desc.en: Changes skill effect order\n(Debuff duration increase applies last)
desc.jp: 効果順番変更\n弱体効果の付与後\n持続ターン増加
desc.kr: 약화 지속 증가 순서 교체\n(가장 마지막에 적용)
desc.zh: 变更弱化持续时间增加的顺序\n(将在最后生效)

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy.
Depending on the unique effect applied to the caster, activates one of the following effects:

Ume Ichirin: Attacks an enemy. Has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color> chance to increase the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color> after attacking.

Sakura, Chiru: Attacks all enemies. Always attacks with <color=#28d9ed>elemental advantage</color>.
desc.jp:
敵単体にダメージを与える。
自分に【梅一輪】または【桜散る】がある場合、次の効果が発動する。

【梅一輪】：敵単体にダメージを与える。<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color>の確率で自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color>UPさせる。

 【桜散る】：敵全体 にダメージを与える。このスキルは敵の属性を無視し、<color=#28d9ed>有利属性</color>の攻撃判定でダメージを与える。
desc.kr:
적을 공격합니다.
보유한 고유 효과에 따라 이하의 효과 중 하나가 적용됩니다.

【우메이치린】 : 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color>의 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.

【사쿠라치루】 : 적 전체를 공격합니다. 항상 <color=#28d9ed>유리한 상성</color>으로 적용됩니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人。
根据附带的固有效果触发以下效果之一。

【一朵梅花】：攻击敌人。攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000065_1_1]</color>的几率使自身<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_1_1]</color>。

【樱花凋零】：攻击全体敌人。总是以<color=#28d9ed>优势属性</color>施展。

desc.en: (Passive Effect)Increases <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> by <color=#28d9ed>15%</color> and increases damage dealt to bosses.\nWhen using <color=#28d9ed>Mikazuki Form 1: Bloom</color>, increases WG damage dealt to enemies by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color>.
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果)<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>上昇し、ボスへの与ダメージが増加する。\n<color=#28d9ed>ミカヅキ壱式：開花</color>使用時、敵へのWGダメージが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color>増加する。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과) <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>15%</color> 증가하고, 보스에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.\n<color=#28d9ed>미카즈키 1식 : 개화</color> 사용 시 적에게 입히는 WG 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: （被动效果）<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提高<color=#28d9ed>15%</color>，对首领怪物造成的伤害提高。\n使用<color=#28d9ed>三日月一式：开花</color>时，对敌方造成的WG伤害提高<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_2_1]</color>。

desc.en:
Attacks an enemy, then grants an extra turn.

Before attacking, if the target's Health is less than or equal to <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, grants the <color=#28d9ed>Ume Ichirin</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1] turn(s)</color> and increases damage dealt.

If the target's Health is greater than <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>, grants the <color=#28d9ed>Sakura, Chiru</color> effect for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2] turn(s)</color> and generates <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color> <color=#28d9ed>Chain Points</color>.
desc.jp:
敵単体にダメージを与え、追加ターンを獲得する。

攻撃前に対象の残りHPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下の場合、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【梅一輪】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与し、与えるダメージがUPする。

対象の残りHPが<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>を超える場合、自分に<color=#28d9ed>【桜散る】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与し、<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color>獲得する。
desc.kr:
적을 공격 후 추가 턴을 획득합니다.

공격 전 대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color> 이하라면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>우메이치린</color> 효과를 획득하고, 피해량이 증가합니다.

대상의 현재 체력이 <color=#28d9ed>90%</color>를 초과한다면 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>사쿠라치루</color> 효과를 획득하고, <color=#28d9ed>CP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color> 회복합니다.
desc.zh:
攻击敌人后获得额外回合。

攻击前，若目标的当前生命值在<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>以下，则获得<color=#28d9ed>一朵梅花</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_1]回合</color>，并使伤害量
提升。

若目标的当前生命值高于<color=#28d9ed>90%</color>，则获得<color=#28d9ed>樱花凋零</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000065_3_2]回合</color>，并恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000065_3_4]</color>点<color=#28d9ed>CP</color>。

desc.en: All Additional Attack effects apply
desc.jp: 条件なしで\nすべての追加効果\n発動
desc.kr: 추가 공격의 효과가 모두 적용
desc.zh: 额外攻击效果全部触发

desc.en: Increases damage
desc.jp: ダメージUP
desc.kr: 피해 증가
desc.zh: 伤害提升

desc.en: Increases Penetration by 30%
desc.jp: 貫通力+30%
desc.kr: 관통력 30% 증가
desc.zh: 穿透力提升30%

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color> chance to reduce the cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>The Culprit is You!</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>【犯人はあなたです!】</color>のスキルターンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1]ターン</color>減少させる。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>범인은 바로 당신!</color> 스킬의 쿨타임을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1]턴</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000066_1_1]</color>的几率使<color=#28d9ed>犯人就是你！</color>的技能冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_1_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: (Triggered Effect) When an ally uses an attack that targets all enemies, grants increased Attack to all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2] turn(s)</color>, and increases Priority of ally Mages by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color>.
desc.jp: (発動効果)味方が全体攻撃時、味方全体の攻撃力を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]ターン</color>の間UPさせ、魔法型の味方の行動ゲージを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color>UPさせる。
desc.kr: (발동 효과) 아군이 전체 공격을 했을 때, 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]턴</color>동안 공격력을 증가시키고, 아군의 마법형 캐릭터는 행동 게이지가 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color> 증가합니다.
desc.zh: (触发效果)友军发动全体攻击时，使全体友军攻击力提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_2_2]回合</color>，并使友军中魔法型角色的行动值提升<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_2_3]</color>。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and increases <color=#28d9ed>Critical Damage</color> of all allies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_3_2] turn(s)</color>.\nAfter using the skill, decreases cooldown of <color=#28d9ed>Thinking Time</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_3_1] turn(s)</color>.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_3_2]ターン</color>の間、味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>会心ダメージ</color>をUPさせる。\nスキル使用後、<color=#28d9ed>シンキングタイム</color>のスキルターンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_3_1]ターン</color>減少させる。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_3_2]턴</color> 동안 아군 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 피해</color>를 증가시킵니다.\n스킬 사용 후 <color=#28d9ed>씽킹 타임</color> 스킬의 쿨타임을 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_3_1]턴</color> 감소시킵니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使我方全体的<color=#28d9ed>暴击伤害</color>提升，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000066_3_2]回合</color>。\n使用技能后，使<color=#28d9ed>思考时间</color>技能的冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000066_3_1]回合</color>。

desc.en: Attacks an enemy and increases own <color=#28d9ed>Priority</color> by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_1_1]</color>.\nDamage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Crit Rate</color>. (up to 50%).
desc.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、自分の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_1_1]</color>UPさせる。\nこのスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする(最大50%)。
desc.kr: 적을 공격하고 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_1_1]</color> 증가시킵니다.\n이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.(최대 50%)
desc.zh: 攻击敌人，并使自身的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>增加<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_1_1]</color>。\n该技能伤害随自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升(最大50%)。

desc.en: (Passive Effect) Regina always gains +10% Miss Chance, and upon entering battle, triggers <color=#28d9ed>Regina's World</color> <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_2_5]</color> time(s). This effect's count decreases when caster is hit.\n(Trigger Effect) When an enemy attack results in a miss, <color=#28d9ed>Show Must Go On</color>'s Cooldown is reduced by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]</color> turn. Counterattacks the attacker when hit. Damage dealt increases in proportion to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color> (up to 50%).
desc.jp: (パッシブ効果) 自分の<color=#28d9ed>ミスヒット発生率</color>が10%UPし、戦闘開始時、<color=#28d9ed>【レジーナワールド】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_2_5]回</color>発生させる。この効果は被弾時に回数が減少する。\n(パッシブ効果) <color=#28d9ed>ミスヒット発生時</color>、<color=#28d9ed>【ショウ・マスト・ゴー・オン】</color>のスキルターンが<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]ターン</color>減少する。被弾時、対象に反撃する。\nこのスキルは自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする(最大50%)。
desc.kr: (패시브 효과) 레지나는 항상 빗나감 확률이 10% 증가하며, 전투 입장 시 <color=#28d9ed>레지나의 세계</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_2_5]회</color> 발생시킵니다. 이 효과는 피격 시 횟수가 차감됩니다.\n(발동 효과) 적 공격이 빗나감 발생 시 <color=#28d9ed>쇼 머스트 고 온</color>의 쿨타임이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]턴</color> 감소합니다. 피격 시 대상에게 반격합니다.\n이 스킬은 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.(최대 50%)
desc.zh: （被动效果）蕾吉纳的闪避概率始终提高10%，进入战斗时触发<color=#28d9ed>蕾吉纳的世界</color><color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_2_5]</color>次。受到攻击时，该效果的次数会减少。\n（触发效果）当敌方攻击发生闪避时，<color=#28d9ed>演出不能停</color>的冷却时间减少<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000067_2_1]</color>回合。被攻击时对目标进行反击。\n该技能的伤害会随着自身<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提高而增加。（最多50%）

desc.en: Dispels all buff effects from the target and attacks an enemy. After attacking, grants <color=#28d9ed>Regina's World</color> <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_3_4] time(s)</color>. This effect decreases by 1 count when hit.\nIgnores <color=#28d9ed>30%</color> of the target's Defense, and damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's <color=#28d9ed>Critical Hit Chance</color>. (up to 50%) The dispelling effect ignores the target's Resilience.
desc.jp:
対象の強化効果をすべて解除し、敵単体にダメージを与える。攻撃後、<color=#28d9ed>【レジーナワールド】</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_3_4]回</color>発生させる。
この効果は被弾時に回数が減少する。
このスキルは対象の防御力を<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>無視し、自分の<color=#28d9ed>会心率</color>が高いほどダメージがUPする(最大50%)。
強化解除効果は対象の効果抵抗を無視する。
desc.kr: 대상의 강화 효과를 모두 해제하고 적을 공격합니다. 공격 후 <color=#28d9ed>레지나의 세계</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_3_4]회</color> 발생시킵니다. 이 효과는 피격 시 횟수가 차감됩니다.\n이 스킬은 대상의 방어력을 <color=#28d9ed>30%</color>무시하며, 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>치명 확률</color>이 높을수록 피해가 증가합니다.(최대 50%) 강화 해제 효과는 대상의 효과 저항을 무시합니다.
desc.zh: 解除目标所有强化效果并攻击敌人。攻击后，生成<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000067_3_4]次</color><color=#28d9ed>蕾吉娜的世界</color>。该效果受到攻击时次数减少。\n该技能无视目标<color=#28d9ed>30%</color>的防御力，且伤害随自身的<color=#28d9ed>暴击率</color>提升(最大50%)。解除强化效果无视目标的效果抵抗。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies.\nAfter attacking, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_2]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Frozen</color> on all enemies for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_2] turn(s)</color> and has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_3]</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Reduced Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_3] turn(s)</color>.\nRight after using this skill, does not trigger an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response, and increases damage dealt to bosses.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。\n攻撃後、敵全体に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_2]</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>凍結</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与し、<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_3]</color>の確率で敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_3]ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。\nこのスキルでは敵の反撃、復讐、迅速対応が発動しない。また、ボスに与えるダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격합니다.\n공격 후 적 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_2]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_2]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>빙결</color>을 부여하고, <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_3]</color> 확률로 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_3]턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>속도 감소</color>를 부여합니다.\n이 스킬 직후에는 적의 반격, 복수, 신속 대응이 발동하지 않고, 보스에게 입히는 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人。\n攻击后，有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_2]</color>的几率对全体敌人造成<color=#28d9ed>冰冻</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_2]回合</color>，并有<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000068_3_3]</color>的几率造成<color=#28d9ed>速度降低</color>，持续<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000068_3_3]回合</color>。\n此技能发动后，不会触发敌人的反击、复仇、迅速应对效果，且对首领造成的伤害提升。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies, and grants Immortality to the caster for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_1] turn(s)</color>.\nAdditionally, has a <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000069_3_2]</color> chance to inflict Stunned on the enemy for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_2] turn(s)</color>, or for <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_3] turn(s)</color> when the enemy is granted Invulnerability.\nIncreases damage dealt by this attack proportional to the caster's missing Health.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、自分に<color=#28d9ed>不死</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_1]ターン</color>の間付与する。\nまた、無敵状態の敵に<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000069_3_2]</color>の確率でスタンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_3]ターン</color>の間付与し、無敵状態でない敵にはスタンを<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000069_3_2]ターン</color>の間付与する。\nこのスキルは自分の残りHPが低いほど、ダメージがUPする。

伤害量。

desc.kr: 적 2인을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_C_2000070_1_1]</color> 확률로 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_T_2000070_1_1]턴</color> 동안 증가합니다.\n\n이 스킬은 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 보유하고 있을 때 피해가 증가합니다.

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and reduces the <color=#28d9ed>Action Points</color> of all enemies by <color=#28d9ed>20</color>.\n\nIf the target has a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color>, damage dealt increases.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与える。敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>20</color>DOWNさせる。\n\nこのスキルは対象が<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>AP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>20</color> 감소시킵니다.\n\n이 스킬은 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 보유하고 있을 때 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，并使全体敌人的<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>20</color>。\n\n该技能目标附带<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果时，伤害提升。

desc.en: Attacks all enemies and recovers the <color=#28d9ed>Action Points</color> of the caster by <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000070_3_1]</color> for each target damaged.\n\nIf the target has a <color=#28d9ed>Barrier</color>, damage dealt increases.
desc.jp: 敵全体にダメージを与え、ダメージを与えた対象1体ごとに、自分の<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000070_3_1]</color>獲得する。\n\nこのスキルは対象が<color=#28d9ed>シールド</color>状態の場合、ダメージがUPする。
desc.kr: 적 전체를 공격하고, 피해를 준 대상마다 자신의 <color=#28d9ed>AP</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000070_3_1]</color> 회복합니다.\n\n이 스킬은 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>실드</color>를 보유하고 있을 때 피해가 증가합니다.
desc.zh: 攻击全体敌人，每对1个目标造成伤害，则使自身<color=#28d9ed>AP</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>[Buff_V_2000070_3_1]</color>。\n\n该技能目标附带<color=#28d9ed>护盾</color>效果时，伤害提升。

Damage dealt increases proportional to Defense instead of Attack.
